description: Set the published deploy percentage for staged rollout on Chrome Web Store. The new percentage must be higher than the current target. Only available for items with 10,000+ seven-day active users.

itemId.description: Extension item ID (defaults to CWS_ITEM_ID env var)

percentage.description: Deploy percentage (0-100). Must be larger than the current target percentage.

publisherId.description: Publisher ID (defaults to CWS_PUBLISHER_ID env var or 'me')

name: deploy-percentage
